class.name: HTMLElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an element in a parsed HTML layout.
class.description: Obtain a handle from [method HTMLLayout.query_selector] or [method HTMLLabel.query_selector]. A handle belongs to one layout at a time and stays valid across viewport resizes. It follows the element when moved with [method HTMLLayout.adopt_node]. While a handle is held, querying or hitting the same element in its current layout returns the same object. Parsing again, clearing the owning layout, or freeing its owner invalidates it. An invalid handle returns empty results or the supplied attribute default. Use these methods on the main thread. Edits affect this layout only. Other views of the same [HTMLDocument] and the source resource are unaffected. Queries and attribute reads see edits immediately. Geometry is available after the next layout pass. [HTMLLabel] batches edits and emits [signal HTMLLabel.layout_changed] when the new layout is ready. A standalone [HTMLLayout] with a previous viewport reflows on a deferred call, or can be laid out immediately with [method HTMLLayout.layout]. Editing methods return [constant OK] on success and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid handle or invalid arguments.

method.name: attach_shadow
method.description: Creates a shadow tree without moving the host's light DOM children. Returns null for an invalid host, duplicate root, or unsupported mode. Focus delegation is recorded but not yet applied.

method.name: add_class
method.description: Adds a case-sensitive class name if it is absent. The name must be a single non-empty token without ASCII whitespace.

method.name: append_child
method.description: Appends [param child] to the end of this element's children and preserves the subtree's handles. Accepts both unattached elements from [method HTMLLayout.create_element] and existing elements from the same layout. Cycles, moving the document root, and inserting elements into tags that cannot contain them are rejected.

method.name: append_fragment
method.description: Appends all children of [param fragment] to this element. See [method insert_fragment_before].

method.name: clone_node
method.description: Returns a detached copy in the same layout with a new handle. Attributes are copied as written, including IDs. If [param deep] is [code]true[/code], copies descendants, including text and comments, in their original order. Style and geometry are computed when the copy is inserted and laid out. Inputs and text areas keep their current values and whether those values have been edited. Checkboxes also keep their checked state and whether it has been edited. Text selection starts at offset zero. A shallow text area copy retains its current value with empty default text. Returns [code]null[/code] for an invalid handle.

method.name: closest
method.description: Returns the closest matching ancestor, starting with this element. [code]:scope[/code] refers to this element. Returns [code]null[/code] if nothing matches.

method.name: detach
method.description: Detaches this element from its parent and preserves existing handles to the whole subtree. Any one of those handles keeps the detached subtree available for editing and reinsertion in the same layout. Returns [constant OK] if already detached with no parent, or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for the document root or an invalid handle.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: Returns the attribute value, or [param default_value] if the attribute is absent. Attribute names are ASCII case-insensitive. An explicitly empty attribute returns an empty string.

method.name: get_attributes
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the element's HTML attributes. Keys and values are strings. An explicitly empty attribute has an empty string value.

method.name: get_bounding_rect
method.description: Returns the union of the rectangles from [method get_client_rects], or an empty rectangle if there are no boxes.

method.name: get_children
method.description: Returns the direct child elements in document order. Text nodes, comments, and CSS-generated pseudo-elements are excluded.

method.name: get_class_list
method.description: Returns the class names in attribute order. Class names are case-sensitive and appear once in the result.

method.name: get_client_rects
method.description: Returns the axis-aligned bounds of the element's border-box fragments in document pixel coordinates after CSS transforms and before clipping or label scrolling. An inline element may have multiple rectangles. The array is empty before layout or when the element has no layout box.

method.name: get_css_diagnostics
method.description: Returns the CSS declaration diagnostics associated with this element in the current layout. See [method HTMLLayout.get_css_diagnostics] for the dictionary fields.

method.name: get_dataset
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the element's [code]data-*[/code] attributes, using the same key conversion as HTML dataset. For example, [code]data-item-id[/code] becomes [code]itemId[/code].

method.name: get_inner_html
method.description: Serializes the current children as HTML, including text and comments. CSS-generated content is excluded. Escaping and attribute order can differ from the original source.

method.name: get_parent
method.description: Returns the parent element, or [code]null[/code] if this element has no parent.

method.name: get_tag_name
method.description: Returns the element's lowercase HTML tag name.

method.name: get_text_content
method.description: Concatenates the parsed text nodes in document order, including hidden content. Comments and CSS-generated text are excluded. For the laid-out text of the document, see [method HTMLLayout.get_plain_text].

method.name: has_attribute
method.description: Returns whether the element has an attribute with the given name, including an empty attribute.

method.name: has_class
method.description: Returns whether the element has the given case-sensitive class name.

method.name: insert_before
method.description: Moves [param child] before the direct child [param reference]. If [param reference] is [code]null[/code], appends the child. The moved subtree keeps its handles. See [method append_child] for insertion constraints.

method.name: insert_fragment_before
method.description: Moves all children of [param fragment] before the direct child [param reference]. If [param reference] is [code]null[/code], appends them. The fragment must belong to this layout. On success, the fragment is emptied and all moved handles are preserved. Moving a nonempty fragment into the document schedules one layout update. Invalid arguments leave both trees unchanged and return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: matches
method.description: Returns whether this element matches the selector. [code]:scope[/code] refers to this element.

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first matching descendant in document order, or [code]null[/code]. See [method query_selector_all] for the query scope.

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the matching descendants in document order, with each element included once. [code]:scope[/code] refers to this element. Use [code]:scope > .title[/code] to select direct children with the given class. See [method HTMLLayout.query_selector_all] for selector syntax.

method.name: remove
method.description: Removes this element and its subtree from their parent and invalidates their handles. Calling this method on an unattached element with no parent leaves it available for insertion. The document root cannot be removed.

method.name: remove_attribute
method.description: Removes the named HTML attribute, if present. Attribute names are ASCII case-insensitive.

method.name: remove_class
method.description: Removes the given class name if present. See [method add_class] for the name rules.

method.name: remove_child
method.description: Detaches the direct child [param child] while preserving the subtree's handles. See [method detach] for the lifetime of a detached subtree.

method.name: replace_child
method.description: Moves [param new_child] into the position of the direct child [param old_child], then detaches the remaining subtree of [param old_child]. Both subtrees keep their handles. Passing the same element for both arguments leaves the tree unchanged.

method.name: set_attribute
method.description: Adds or updates the named HTML attribute. The value is stored as literal text. An empty value leaves the attribute present.

method.name: set_inner_html
method.description: Parses [param html] in the context of this element and replaces its children. The replaced descendants' handles become invalid. Empty HTML clears the children. Use [method set_text_content] to insert literal text.

method.name: set_text_content
method.description: Replaces the children with literal text and invalidates the replaced descendants' handles. Empty text clears the children.

method.name: toggle_class
method.description: Toggles the given class name when [param force] is [code]null[/code]. Pass [code]true[/code] to add it or [code]false[/code] to remove it. Use [method has_class] to read the resulting state.

method.name: get_first_element_child
method.description: Returns the first direct element child, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_last_element_child
method.description: Returns the last direct element child, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_child_element_count
method.description: Returns the number of direct element children.

method.name: replace_children
method.description: Replaces the child nodes with the given nodes, plain strings, and fragments. Removed nodes retain their handles.

method.name: get_previous_element_sibling
method.description: Returns the preceding sibling element, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_next_element_sibling
method.description: Returns the following sibling element, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_elements_by_tag_name
method.description: Returns the descendant elements with the given tag name as a snapshot.

method.name: get_elements_by_class_name
method.description: Returns descendants matching all of the whitespace-separated class names.

method.name: get_attribute_names
method.description: Returns a snapshot of source attribute names.

method.name: has_attributes
method.description: Returns whether the element has any source attributes.

method.name: toggle_attribute
method.description: Toggles an attribute, or sets its presence to [param force]. Returns whether the attribute is now present.

method.name: replace_class
method.description: Replaces a class token while preserving token order. Returns whether the replacement was applied.

method.name: set_dataset_value
method.description: Sets a [code]data-*[/code] attribute from a dataset key.

method.name: remove_dataset_value
method.description: Removes the attribute for the given dataset key.

method.name: insert_adjacent_element
method.description: Inserts an element at [code]beforebegin[/code], [code]afterbegin[/code], [code]beforeend[/code], or [code]afterend[/code].

method.name: insert_adjacent_text
method.description: Inserts plain text at a position accepted by [method insert_adjacent_element].

method.name: insert_adjacent_html
method.description: Parses and inserts markup at a position accepted by [method insert_adjacent_element].

method.name: get_outer_html
method.description: Serializes the element and its contents as HTML.

method.name: set_outer_html
method.description: Replaces the element with parsed markup and retains this handle as a detached element.

method.name: get_inner_text
method.description: Returns text with CSS visibility, casing, whitespace, and structural line breaks applied. Without a rendered element, returns the source text content.

method.name: set_inner_text
method.description: Replaces the child nodes with plain text, converting line endings to HTML line breaks where allowed.

method.name: append
method.description: Appends the items at the end of this element. The array accepts nodes, plain strings, and fragments.

method.name: prepend
method.description: Inserts the items at the beginning of this element. The array accepts nodes, plain strings, and fragments.

method.name: before
method.description: Inserts the items directly before this element. The array accepts nodes, plain strings, and fragments.

method.name: after
method.description: Inserts the items directly after this element. The array accepts nodes, plain strings, and fragments.

method.name: replace_with
method.description: Replaces this element with the given items and retains this handle as a detached element. The array accepts nodes, plain strings, and fragments.

method.name: get_client_size
method.description: Returns the untransformed padding box size. The root uses the viewport size.

method.name: get_client_offset
method.description: Returns the left and top border widths in layout pixels.

method.name: get_offset_parent
method.description: Returns the reference element for [method get_offset_rect], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_offset_rect
method.description: Returns the first border box position and the combined border box size in layout pixels. Position is relative to the offset parent's padding box. CSS transforms and scroll offsets are excluded.

method.name: get_scroll_size
method.description: Returns the extent of the scrollable content, including padding.

method.name: get_scroll_offset
method.description: Returns the current scroll offset of this inner scroll container in CSS pixels.

method.name: set_scroll_offset
method.description: Sets the inner scroll offset immediately, clamped to the scrollable extent. Use [method HTMLLabel.set_scroll_offset] for the outer viewport.

method.name: scroll_to
method.description: Sets the inner scroll position to the specified offset.

method.name: scroll_by
method.description: Adds the specified delta to the current inner scroll position.

method.name: get_style_property
method.description: Returns the inline CSS value, or an empty string if the property has no serializable inline value.

method.name: get_style_property_priority
method.description: Returns [code]important[/code] for an important inline property, or an empty string otherwise.

method.name: get_style_properties
method.description: Returns a snapshot of inline property names and their serialized values.

method.name: set_style_property
method.description: Sets one inline CSS property. Pass [code]important[/code] separately for high priority. An empty value removes the property. Invalid inputs preserve existing declarations.

method.name: remove_style_property
method.description: Removes the inline property and returns its previous value. A longhand can be removed from a shorthand when the remaining declarations can be represented separately.

method.name: get_animations
method.description: Returns the animation handles for this element, including its generated pseudo-elements.

method.name: set_pointer_capture
method.description: Captures an active pointer to this connected element. Later pointer events for that pointer target this element until capture is released or the pointer ends.

method.name: release_pointer_capture
method.description: Releases this pointer's active capture. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if the pointer is not captured by an element.

method.name: has_pointer_capture
method.description: Returns whether this element currently captures the pointer.

method.name: animate
method.description: Creates a scripted animation on this element. See [method HTMLLayout.animate] for keyframes and timing options.

members.member: Whether this element is inside an editable region. [code]contenteditable="true"[/code] and [code]contenteditable="plaintext-only"[/code] enable editing; an explicit [code]false[/code] descendant stops inherited editing. The value also reflects document [member HTMLDocumentNode.design_mode].
Reflects the raw HTML class attribute.
Reflects the element's own HTML language attribute.
Reflects whether the hidden attribute is present.
Reflects whether the inert attribute is present.
Reflects the explicit tab index, or returns the default for the element type.
